title: Handcuffed Suspect Crawls Through Backseat Barrier & Steals Police Car
description:
On April 25, 2021, police responded to a suspected break-in in Rothschild, WI. When police arrived, they found a stolen vehicle parked on the sidewalk with the engine running with no one inside. 

A witness believed they saw someone break into the pickup truck and go inside the house. The officers went to the home, searched for a suspect, and discovered a man hiding in the bathroom. 

He was taken into custody and placed in the squad car. While officers interviewed witnesses, the man was able to fit himself through the one-foot barrier between the front and back seats and took off with the squad car.
